title: Swampert 021/069 Korean Eevee Heroes Holographic MINT/NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Swampert card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector! It features an alternative art, reverse holo, holo, altered/custom art, 1st edition, and foil finish. The card is from the Eevee Heroes set and has a card number of 021/069. It is a water-type creature with 90 HP and is manufactured by Nintendo. 

The card is in near mint or better condition and is a standard size. It is a rare card with a regular finish and is suitable for ages 6 and up. The Swampert card is not autographed and is written in Korean. Get your hands on this amazing card today!
